categories.main_business_segments: MLOPTIC Corp. primarily operates in the precision optics industry, focusing on the design, research, manufacturing, and sales of precision optical components, lenses, and optical systems. Key application areas include semiconductor (including lithography and semiconductor inspection equipment), life sciences (gene sequencing and oral scanning), aerospace, autonomous driving, biometrics, and AR/VR inspection. The company offers customized industrial-grade precision optical products tailored to client needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including precision optical coating, ultra-smooth polishing, high-precision optical bonding, optical lens and system design, and low-stress high-precision assembly. Manufacturing methods involve advanced polishing techniques (CCP, SPDT, MRF), coating technologies covering deep ultraviolet to infrared spectra, and integrated optical-mechanical-electrical-computing solutions. R&D focuses on high numerical aperture microscope objectives, large-aperture optical systems, and high-damage-threshold laser optical components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: MLOPTIC serves global leading high-tech enterprises and key research institutions in semiconductor manufacturing, life sciences (gene sequencing, medical imaging), aerospace, autonomous driving (LiDAR systems), biometrics, and AR/VR device testing. Its customers include semiconductor equipment manufacturers, medical device companies, aerospace agencies, and automotive sensor developers, with a strong presence in North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Nanjing, China, with production facilities in Thailand and subsidiaries in the United States, United Kingdom, and Hong Kong. Its sales and service network covers major developed markets including North America, Europe, Middle East, and other Asian regions, supporting both domestic and international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: MLOPTIC operates primarily in the midstream segment of the optical supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of precision optical components, lenses, and integrated optical systems. It provides customized products and integrated solutions to downstream high-tech equipment manufacturers and research institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment (~14% of revenue) to maintain technological leadership in precision optics. Strategic R&D directions include ultra-precision polishing, deep ultraviolet and high-power laser coating, large-aperture optical system design, and integrated optical-mechanical-electrical-computing solutions. It actively pursues innovation in semiconductor inspection optics, AR/VR optical testing, and autonomous driving sensor optics, while expanding global R&D and manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: MLOPTIC generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized precision optical components, lenses, and optical systems to global high-tech customers. It also earns income from technical services and integrated solution provision. The company engages in project-based R&D collaboration with clients, securing orders through early-stage technical involvement and customization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: MLOPTIC is positioned as a leading domestic precision optics manufacturer with strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' and manufacturing 'single champion' enterprise. It competes with large domestic and international optical companies in high-end precision optics, focusing on differentiated customized products for strategic emerging industries. The company leverages vertical integration and global presence to enhance competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, MLOPTIC achieved revenue of approximately RMB 502.8 million, representing a 9.78% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by semiconductor business growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 35.5 million, a 23.98% decrease from the previous year. Total assets grew by 7.71% to RMB 1.46 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MLOPTIC differentiates itself through rapid response to customer needs and highly customized precision optical products. It offers integrated optical-mechanical-electrical-computing solutions, combining advanced design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities. The company’s products meet stringent technical requirements across multiple high-tech fields, supported by strong innovation, vertical integration, and global service networks, providing customers with high-quality, reliable, and tailored optical solutions.
